en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 13. My father and a group of my scholars narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā Al-‘Aťťar, and from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from ‘Amraki, from someone who narrated to him, from Ḥammād ibn ‘Isā, from Ḥusain ibn Mukhtār, who said:
I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) about the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Imam (a.s.) replied, “(The reward for) Hajj and ‘Umrah is in it.”
